state.paragraph: In mid-June 2016, at the direction of the Transaction Committee, representatives of GHF instructed all potential buyers to submit non-binding letters of intent ("LOIs") by July 20, 2016, together with mark-ups of the forms of merger agreement, disclosure letter and voting agreement, which GHF indicated would be posted to the internet data site. Potential buyers were instructed to provide a valuation for the Company based on the purchase of 100% of the outstanding common stock on a dollar per share basis (assuming conversion of the preferred stock into common stock) or the financial terms of any non-cash proposal.

ledger_rows.Note: Potential buyers advised to submit non-binding indications of interest by 05/10/2016; communicated before the 04/27 Board meeting.
IOI deadline postponed to 05/19/2016 to let buyers formulate compelling offers; revision itself undated, only bound is the new date.
IOI due date reached; nine IOIs followed; the Transaction Committee evaluated them on 05/23 and 06/01.
Excluded after IOI review as the lowest of the nine offers; decision made at the 05/23 and 06/01 Committee meetings.
Round 2 opened: Committee advanced seven after excluding two, opening management presentations and data-site diligence; LOIs later sought by 07/20.
Signed a confidentiality agreement and received the same memorandum as other buyers; no standstill.
IOI; equity value $108M; no diligence or financing terms stated; made before data-site and management access.
Provided catch-up access for late entrant: data-site access plus telephone management presentation after its 07/12 IOI.

nda_access.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a party signs a confidentiality agreement, or is given (or denied) data room access, management meetings, projections or other diligence information. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
